svg.title: N0zoM1z0 · Contribution Arcade · 06 / CITY
svg.desc: 13,956 GitHub contributions across 138 active days, 2025-10-12 to 2026-10-14. Each active week develops from a foundation through a structural frame to a finished building. Its exact weekly contribution total controls skyline height; quiet weeks leave a gap.

g.text: ONE BUILDING PER ACTIVE WEEK · HEIGHT = WEEKLY CONTRIBUTIONS
